column4: Divineguma Act, No. 1 of 2013
The objects of the divineguma  community based
to improve the social and economic conditions of
divineguma  members    resident  within  its  area  of
authority;
to  identify    livelihood  development  opportunities
and  its  potential;
to provide assistance and aid that are required for
the  livelihood  development  activities,  under  the
guidance of the Department;
to develop the physical and human resources that
are required for the improvement of the livelihood
activities;
to provide such opportunities as may be required
to  improve  the  saving  habits  of  divineguma
beneficiaries;
to  expand    the  opportunities  that  are  available  in
obtaining micro financial facilities and to improve
the  investment  capabilities;
to  uplift  the  level  of  education  and  skills  of
divineguma beneficiaries and their families;
to provide raw materials,  consultancy services and
technological facilities as may be required for the
promotion  of  production  and  productivity;
to provide facilities for storage  and processing of
any products of divineguma beneficiaries and for
the promotion of marketing of such products; and
to develop self-confidence, collective responsibility
towards  society,  good  qualities  and  values  of
divineguma  beneficiaries.
